cohort: 100 parturient (ASA grades I and II, aged 18-35 years) undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Both metoclopramide and dexamethasone were effective in reducing nausea and vomiting, with dexamethasone being more effective for postoperative nausea and vomiting, and metoclopramide being more effective during cesarean section.
